title: Expanded Rune Construction bounded reference corpus
authority_note: These are deterministic design/QA constructions exercising the expanded 34-rune vocabulary. They do not replace retained spells or assign final mana, level, damage, healing, save, XP, resistance, counterspell, Resonance, Overreach, crafting, or balance values.

cases.title: Fire bolt
cases.acceptance: Creates/routes fire without defining damage or mana from syntax.

cases.title: Cone of cold
cases.acceptance: Cold and cone geometry remain separate reusable concepts.

cases.title: Chained lightning
cases.acceptance: LINK provides chain routing; target count/range remain owning-rule inputs.

cases.title: Gale push
cases.acceptance: Air is the medium and MOVE is forced-motion intent.

cases.title: Water current
cases.acceptance: Water movement does not require a unique named spell rune.

cases.title: Stone wall
cases.acceptance: Earth creation and wall geometry compose independently.

cases.title: Acid field
cases.acceptance: Area, persistence and damage remain external rule inputs.

cases.title: Force barrier
cases.acceptance: Ward semantics and force medium create a barrier route without inventing durability.

cases.title: Radiant restoration
cases.acceptance: Healing and a radiant support property remain separate operations.

cases.title: Void unraveling
cases.acceptance: UNMAKE routes destruction/negation but does not bypass dispel, resistance, durability, or save rules.

cases.title: Charm
cases.acceptance: Mental influence requires owning Will/resistance rules and valid target eligibility.

cases.title: Call spirit
cases.acceptance: Calling does not invent a spirit or override setting/source availability.

cases.title: Verdant restraint
cases.acceptance: Natural growth plus binding covers entangling effects without a unique spell rune.

cases.title: Teleport
cases.acceptance: SPACE enables relocation semantics while destination and planar restrictions remain owning-rule inputs.

cases.title: Temporal stasis
cases.acceptance: Time-domain restraint does not define duration or bypass saves.

cases.title: Silence ward
cases.acceptance: A ward against sound covers silence/suppression without inventing area/duration.

cases.title: Invisibility veil
cases.acceptance: Optical concealment is expressed through VEIL plus LIGHT; detection interactions remain external.

cases.title: Detect magic
cases.acceptance: Permission filtering precedes hidden magical-reference labels, counts, previews, diagnostics and AI context.

cases.title: Planar banishment
cases.acceptance: Banishment requires valid target/destination authority and does not assume every target is exilic.

cases.title: Flaming weapon inscription
cases.acceptance: PPIA-03 retains Item ownership; materials, capacity, time and crafting DC remain typed adapters.

cases.title: Freeze water transformation
cases.acceptance: CHANGE declares the transformation without assuming arbitrary mass/range or target permission.

cases.title: Life siphon
cases.acceptance: Drain/transfer route does not invent amount, healing conversion, resistance, or immunity.

cases.title: Arcane relay
cases.acceptance: Generic arcane medium is allowed only where no narrower source/owning domain is required.

cases.title: Light globe
cases.acceptance: Illumination remains independent from radiance damage or healing assumptions.

cases.title: Read emotions
cases.acceptance: Perception does not bypass privacy, immunity, resistance, or hidden-reference filtering.

cases.title: Psychic illusion
cases.acceptance: Mind-facing illusion stays distinct from optical LIGHT concealment.

cases.title: Necrotic ward
cases.acceptance: Protection from void/necrotic effects does not assign the resistance amount.

cases.title: Mixed elemental storm
cases.acceptance: Multiple essences require explicit grouped composition rather than implicit payload-list precedence.

cases.title: Arcane dispel
cases.acceptance: The owning dispel/countermagic rule decides success and scope.

cases.title: Spirit ward
cases.acceptance: Spirit-facing wards preserve source/setting definitions of valid spirits and undead.

cases.title: Invalid standalone essence
cases.acceptance: Essence runes are typed payload glyphs, not standalone executable operation nodes in v0.2.0.

cases.title: Invalid implicit dual payload
cases.acceptance: Dual essences use explicit WITH branches; payload-list syntax is not invented.

cases.title: Hidden target permission guardrail
cases.acceptance: Unauthorized users receive no existence, label, count, metric, cost, diagnostic, export, notification, or AI-context leak.

cases.title: Idempotent enchantment recovery
cases.acceptance: Ambiguous authoritative writes check operation/current-version status before retrying with the same operation_id; resource consumption and inscription are not duplicated.
